company.shortDescription: PageLever is an analytics platform for measuring a specific brand’s presence on Facebook.
company.description:
PageLever is the leading analytics platform for measuring your brand’s presence on Facebook.

4 of the top 10 Facebook pages rely on PageLever, as well as brands like YouTube, MTV, and Intel.

In January 2013, PageLever was acquired by [Unified Social](http://www.unifiedsocial.com/).
